Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 19727 of 2024

Applicant :- Avinash Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Kumar Tiwari,Vinod Shanker Giri
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Rejoinder affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Arun Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri R.N. Srivastava, learned AGA for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.653 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Banda, during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Banda
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members on 21.08.2023 and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the daughter of the informant on 28.06.2020 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for additional dowry and in this regard, in the year 2022 an FIR was lodged against applicant and his family members under Sections 498-A, 312, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, in which after investigation charge-sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: It is further mentioned in the FIR that applicant also threatened the daughter of the informant that he will defame her in such manner that she will commit suicide and thereafter, he will lead happy life along with some other lady.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that daughter of the informant also filed an applications under Section 125 Cr.P.C. and under Section 12 of Domestic Violence Act against the applicant and due to the torture of the applicant and his family members on 30.07.2023, his daughter committed suicide in her rented house.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture he has been made accused in the present along with his other family members and admittedly, some matrimonial dispute was pending between applicant and his wife and thereafter, wife started living separately from him and she committed suicide in her rented house and admittedly, she did not commit suicide in the house of the applicant i.e. her matrimonial home.

7. He further submits, if due to matrimonial dispute, wife started living separately from her husband and thereafter, she committed suicide while living separately then husband cannot be dragged for offence under Section 304-B IPC.
He next submits that Postmortem Report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
8. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since 27.09.2023 i.e. for last more than a year.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within 7 years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that matrimonial dispute was pending between husband and wife and in this regard wife also lodged number of cases against the applicant for maintenance and under the provisions of Dowry Prohibition Act.

10. Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that deceased lived separately from her husband i.e. applicant and Postmortem Report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging.
11.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within 7 years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but admittedly,
deceased did not die in her matrimonial home rather it reflects that she died in her rented home as she started living separately from the applicant.

Record further suggests that long matrimonial dispute was pending between the parties and deceased also filed an application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. and under Section 12 of Domestic Violence Act against the applicant and this Court finds merit in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that if due to matrimonial dispute wife started living separately from her husband and thereafter, she committed suicide by hanging herself then husband cannot be dragged for offence under Section 304-B IPC.

sentences.text: Further, apart from the matrimonial dispute, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since 27.09.2023 i.e. for last more than a year 14.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant - Avinash Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 11.11.2024 S.A.
